shared_elements: row/register of figures facing the same direction
low-relief carved figures on a flat rectangular panel
bearded male figures in long garments
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow-relief bearded male figures shown in strict profile, aligned in a single horizontal register and all facing the same direction, and both use a comparable convention of outlined bodies with patterned garment detail against a plain ground. The subject matter diverges sharply, however: A is dominated by a large field of dense inscribed text with only a small arched panel of static, apparently ceremonial figures beside emblems, while B is a continuous narrative of armed men with bows advancing on a walled, towered structure, with no text at all.
